title: Dealmakers Podcast Ep 14
description:
Accounting Practice Sales is a discipline of it's own in small business acquisitions. 

Our own, Sara Sharp herself specializes in Accounting Firm Acquisitions. 

In this episode, Daniel and Sara talk to a Business Broker who's been working with CPAs and Accounting Firm owners nearly his entire life... literally since he was 16 years old.

Todd Steinberg, owner of Thrive Group, has consulted countless accountants on the growth or sale of their firms. 

He shares with us how to value an accounting firm, how to position yourself as an ideal buyer, and how to niche as an industry expert.
